canonicalization: UTF-8, no BOM, JSON keys sorted recursively, separators comma and colon, newline forbidden

invariants.run_schema_sha256: SHA-256 of this exact schema file, encoded as 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits
invariants.source_commit: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits identifying a clean tree
invariants.record_order: single-thread game ordinal then game ply

openbench.campaign_id: equal to the top-level campaign slug

invariants.retry: the same logical chunk must reproduce identical uncompressed bytes across workers; producer and worker-resource attestations live in the external OpenBench receipt

acceptance.native_relation_coverage: SAME and OTHER must both be nonzero for both king perspectives; at least 1000 records per million must contain both relations for both perspectives
acceptance.board_coverage: both king boards and both move-source boards must be nonzero
acceptance.target_coverage: all three result labels, captures, promotions, and castling must be nonzero
